question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"put."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Put"** is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
 
• It is a verb that means to place something somewhere. (किसी को किसी स्‍थान या स्थिति में रखना या डालना)
 
 
• **Example:** *She put__ the book on the table.*
 
 
 
• The sentence suggests that something needs to be placed or inserted in the blank.
 
• Grammatically, **"put"** is a simple present tense verb that agrees with the subject of the sentence.
 
• The correct answer is option 4.
 
• Correct passage:

The world is going through a deep recession. At such a time, one thing we need in abundance is jobs for the semi-skilled and unskilled. This is the only way in which equal __distribution__ of wealth can take place. The healthcare industry is ideally poised to occupy this position. The IT industry hires people from the upper-middle strata and rich families, usually engineers, __whereas__ the health care industry hires nurses, to the tune of eighty per cent of the jobs created, from the lower economic strata. Global health care is a 4.5-trillion rupee industry, second only to the agro-industry. Even then, health care __reaches__ only eight per cent of the world's population. Policymakers should look at the healthcare industry as not only an industry which addresses pain but also as one which can __influence__ the economy. The last century was driven by machines that addressed human toil and it is strongly believed that this century will be driven by health care. This, however, will only happen if policymakers make a conscious effort to __**put**__ the right policies in place soon.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Desire"** is a noun that means a strong feeling of wanting or wishing for something. (अत्‍यधिक चाह; तीव्र इच्‍छा)
 
• **"Cut"** is a verb that means to divide or separate something with a sharp tool or object. ((चाक़ू, कैंची आदि से) काटना, कतरना)
 
• **"Design"** is a verb that means to plan or create something with a specific purpose or intention. (किसी वस्‍तु की निर्माण की योजना और रूपरेखा बनाना)
